c4e — package repo

Source: AGENTS.md
  • This is the R package c4e, the successor of climatic4economist, started from its v2 redesign. Development happens on short branches merged into main. Write access covers R/, tests/, man/, vignettes/, inst/, dev/, .github/, DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, NEWS.md, README.md. Raw data outside the repo stays read-only; inst/extdata/ holds only synthetic fixtures.
  • Start every session by reading dev/LOG_v2.md (status and next steps), then the relevant section of dev/PLAN_v2.md. Run the test suite to confirm the recorded state before changing anything.
  • End every session by updating the log: status row, current chunk, next steps, blocked items, a dated entry (did / found / tests / next / commits). Commit the log with the code. Ask before pushing.
  • Deviations from dev/PLAN_v2.md go in the log’s decisions table, and the plan is edited in the same commit.
  • One chunk per pull request into main.
  • Style: tidyverse, native pipe, explicit namespacing (c4e:: in scripts), cli for messages, testthat 3rd edition; every exported function has tests on the synthetic fixtures in inst/extdata/.
  • Verify before claiming a step done: "/c/Program Files/R/R-4.5.0/bin/Rscript.exe" -e 'testthat::test_local()' on the FAO laptop where R is not on the PATH, and R CMD check with no errors or warnings.
